lines.en: label day30:
scene drown0
And so ends another uneventful day as a school teacher.
I’ve gotta say, the fact that I've made it this far without being fired or reprimanded is either extremely impressive on my end, or extremely worrying on the school's.
But hey, the fact that none of the staff members have caught on to the person I really am yet is definitely good for me.
It also shows that, for whatever reason, the girls have some level of trust in me.
I guess it's a little strange that Yumi hasn't ratted me out to the higher ups, but...well, I guess she hasn't really had the time to do that with all of her absences.
For all she knows, this might be how Sensei has been doing things all along.
scene drown1
I step into the cafe for a quick drink in the midst of my aimless wandering and hope that there is someone or something in here with the potential to entertain me for the rest of the day.
And, noticing two students of mine no more than twenty feet away from me, I realize that I have once again accidentally manifested exactly what I have been looking for.
scene drown2
: Woah, Sensei?! What are you doing here?!
: Wait, really? He’s never here this late.
scene drown3
: Sensei! Come hang out with us! We were actually just talking about you!
scene drown5
: Were you?
: Yeah! Nothing super interesting, though. Just how we're happy to have you as our teacher and not any of the other ones.
: Does that have anything to do with how I've given up on assigning schoolwork?
: I mean...that definitely helps!
: So, what are you up to? It's not every day I see you two together.
scene drown6
: Right? I was just telling Rin that the other day that we need to hang out more.
: Hahah...I'm Rin.
: That's...a thing that I was told.
: I’m not...interrupting anything, am I?
: No way! Not at all!
: Besides, shouldn't you be trying to hang out with us after that whole let's be friends thing?
: Friends don't just walk past other friends, Sensei. That'd be like, totally messed up.
: Hey, I agree. I just didn't want to be interrupting a date or anything.
scene drown7
: Hahahah! A date?!
: I guess it does kinda look like that, doesn't it?!
: Please don't leave me.
Something tells me I probably shouldn't leave Rin right now.
It's her. She's the one who tells me that.
: Well, I’m happy to hang out here if you two are okay with it. And I guess just...tell me to leave if you wind up wanting to be alone or something.
scene drown8
: I think we'll be okay. But it's nice knowing that you'd support us if things were a little different, Sensei.
: Hahah...hah...
: Everything okay, Rin?
scene drown9
: Huh? What? Yeah. I'm good. Green as a cucumber.
: Isn't it cool as a cucumber?
scene drown10
: It is kind of cool in here, isn't it?! Should I turn the heat up? I know it's summer and that it will conflict with the air conditioner, but if that's what you-
: What? No. I meant, like...the phrase. Isn't the phrase as cool as a cucumber?
scene drown10r
: Hahah! Yeah! They are pretty cool, aren't they?!
Wow.
Rin is...not very good around Chika, is she?
scene drown11
: You know...maybe Sensei's onto something? You have seemed kinda weird ever since we got here. Are you sure everything is okay?
: You don’t like, feel uncomfortable hanging out with me...do you?
scene drown12
: What?! No! Of course not! It's not like that at all!
: I’m just...really tired!
: I didn’t sleep much last night and I’m like, totally running on fumes right now.
: You sure it’s not me? I know I can be kinda chatty sometimes, but that's just because-
: Totally sure! You’re not doing anything wrong! You’re great, in fact! So great! Way better than I am!
: And, umm...
: Uhh!
scene drown13
: Help.
I think you might be a little past helping right now, Rin...But I'll do my best.
: Wow. I sure am hungry right now. If only there was some place to get food around here...
scene drown13r
: Yes! Food! I will go find us food!
: I work here, so I know where we keep all of it!
: Three foods, coming right Chika!
scene drown13r2
: Up! Coming right up! Not Chika. Chika is you! Not coming at all!
: Uhhh...
: Okay, bye! Thank you!
scene drown15
scene drown16
: It’s me, isn’t it?
: I like, totally wasn’t picking up on her cues or anything. I’m talking way too much again, I know it.
: God...I told myself I would do this and everything. I'm so disappointed in myself right now.
: I don’t really think that’s the problem, Chika.
: Then what is it? There's no way she's just tired, right? She's yelling way too much for someone who's that tired.
: She was totally fine at[school], too...She didn't start acting weird until we got here.
: It’s like the second we’re alone, some...switch flips and she turns into a completely different person.
: I just don't want it to be my fault, you know? I thought this would be fun.
: Well, are you having fun?
scene drown17
: I mean...I wanna say yeah...
: But, like...I can’t help but feel like I’m just bothering her right now.
: I’ve known Rin for years now and the two of us haven’t ever really...hung out before.
: I don't know. I just feel like it's supposed to feel a lot more...natural than this.
: I've gone out with plenty of girlfriends before and none of them have ever acted this...out of place with me. Is it our styles, maybe?
: I know we don't have that much in common, but it's not like I'm totally uninterested in any of the stuff she's into. I just don't know much about it. And-
: Chika, I get it. And I think you're worrying too much.
: I’m sure everything will work out as long as neither of you make a big deal out of it.
: She’s probably just having an off day or something.
scene drown16
: I really hope that’s all it is...
: I've always, like...
: Kind of wanted to be friends with her and stuff. She's so...unique.
scene drown18
: Okay, I'm back...sorry about that.
: I...forgot to ask what everyone wanted, so...I just ordered a bunch of stuff that we can all split.
: My manager said it's on her today, too...so...I guess that's kind of cool. Right?
: Yeah...Yeah, that's totally fine.
scene drown19
: Hey, Rin?
: Hm? What's up?
: I’m sorry if I was...making you feel uncomfortable or anything. I just-
scene drown20
: What? Chika, no! I’m totally fine.
: Like I said, I'm just tired. I...get like this sometimes. I just needed to reset really quick, that's all.
: Plus, as soon as my coffee cools down and I can get some caffeine into my system, I'm sure I'll be right as a cucumber.
: I'm pretty sure it's right as r-
: You know what? Forget it. I'm glad you're feeling better. But just...let me know if I wind up annoying you, okay?
scene drown21
: Yeah...
: Yeah, I can do that.
: I'm sorry too. For...making things awkward and stuff. And...and for all of the cucumber analogies.
: I can assure you that I don't spend any more time thinking about cucumbers than the average girl.
: Probably even less, to be honest. They're all weird and...
: And bumpy...
: And...uhh...
: ...And cool?
scene drown22
: Pfft!
scene drown23
: Hahah...hahahah!
: Thank you, Sensei. Let me know if there's anything I can do to make it up to you, okay?
scene black
I wind up leaving the cafe before any of the food arrives so the two of them can spend some more time together.
It's pretty clear what was going on here today, but...
Well, let's just say there's no need for me to get in the way right now. Not while everything is still so fresh...
And certainly not before I know either of them well enough to even want to get myself caught in the early stages of the mess this may become.
I'll remain on the sidelines for now. I don't have to start every single game.
But...when I do-
I'll be sure to make an impact.
$ rin_love += 1
$ chika_love += 1
$ day30 = True
Rin's affection has increased to [rin_love]!
Chika's affection has increased to [chika_love]!
Before I know it, the day has come to an end and I am on my way home.
